ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A 3-line to 8-line decoder with active-low outputs is used to implement a 3-variable Boolean function as shown in the image. Write the simplified Product of Sum form of the implemented Boolean function.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the diagram: on the left side of the diagram is a decoder labeled 3L×8L Decoder, with the input terminals marked as Z connected to A0, Y connected to A1, X connected to A2; the output terminals on the right side are numbered 0 to 7, and the small circles on the output terminals indicate active low. On the right side is an OR gate whose input terminals have small circles, and the decoder outputs connected to this gate in the diagram are 1, 3, 5, 6, with the gate output being F. Then reason: let X=A2, Y=A1, Z=A0. After the active-low decoder outputs are connected to an OR gate with bubble inputs, it equivalently implements the sum of the minterms corresponding to these numbers, so F=Σm(1,3,5,6). Therefore the combinations for which F is 1 are 001, 011, 101, 110, and the combinations for which F is 0 are 0, 2, 4, 7. Perform POS simplification on the 0 cells: 0 and 2 are grouped, and the two have X=0 and Z=0 in common, obtaining the sum term (X+Z); 0 and 4 are grouped, and the two have Y=0 and Z=0 in common, obtaining the sum term (Y+Z); 7, namely 111, is an isolated 0 cell, obtaining the maxterm (\bar{X}+\bar{Y}+\bar{Z}). Multiplying gives the simplified POS as (X+Z)(\bar{X}+\bar{Y}+\bar{Z})(Y+Z).

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the selected active-low decoder outputs entering the bubbled-input OR as 1, 3, 5, and 6, with inputs ordered X=A2, Y=A1, Z=A0. Convert these selected outputs to the ON-set F=Σm(1,3,5,6). Fill a 3-variable K-map/truth table with 1s at 1,3,5,6 and 0s elsewhere, then group the 0-cells to obtain the simplified POS. The zero group for indices 0 and 2 gives (X+Z), the zero group for indices 0 and 4 gives (Y+Z), and the isolated zero at 7 gives (X̄+Ȳ+Z̄). Multiply these sums.

Write the canonical POS as ΠM(0,2,4,7). 推理：由于译码器输出是低有效，且输出线 1、3、5、6 接入带输入反相的 OR 门，所以函数 F 在地址 1、3、5、6 时为 1；因此 F 的 OFF-set 是其余地址 0、2、4、7。于是 canonical POS 为 F=ΠM(0,2,4,7)。在三变量零值 K-map 中，对零单元 0(000) 和 2(010) 分组，X=0、Z=0 不变，得到和项 (X+Z)；对零单元 0(000) 和 4(100) 分组，Y=0、Z=0 不变，得到和项 (Y+Z)；零单元 7(111) 单独保留，得到最大项 (X̄+Ȳ+Z̄)。因此简化的 Product of Sum 形式为 (X+Z)(Y+Z)(X̄+Ȳ+Z̄)。
